mapper.select: select l.* from nad_application_letter l where l.application_id = #{applicationId} and l.id = (select max(x.id) from nad_application_letter x where x.application_id = l.application_id and x.kind = l.kind) order by l.kind
mapper.insert: insert into nad_application_letter (application_id, kind, media_id, original_filename, uploaded_by, create_by, create_time) values (#{applicationId}, #{kind}, #{mediaId}, #{originalFilename}, #{uploadedBy}, #{createBy}, now())
